Budavár (Castle District, Víziváros, Tabán, Krisztinaváros) (1. kerület) — Budapest, Hungary

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Budapest's historic Castle District, one of the city's two districts repeatedly named as its safest. A 2022 police-data comparison found District I had the lowest residential-burglary count of any of Budapest's 23 districts (12 cases, versus 113 in the worst-affected district), and a July 2025 crime-hotspot map (based on the prior 30 days of citywide police data) named Districts I and XII explicitly as "exceptionally safe." It is not named in any of the theft, burglary, or nightlife-disorder hotspot lists checked for this build. Sources checked: Index.hu, 16 May 2022 (district burglary comparison, PRE-STAT data); Metropol.hu, 20 Jul 2025 (30-day crime-hotspot map).
